delivery.russiaDesc: 3–5 days via CDEK or Russian Post. Exact cost is known at checkout
delivery.happyPoint1: we will agree on a convenient time with you
delivery.happyPoint2: courier will call an hour before delivery

delivery.payCashDesc: You can pay cash both in store and upon home delivery — our couriers always have change. Before paying, you can verify the quality of the device.
delivery.payCard: Bank card in store / to courier
delivery.payCardDesc: Whether you pick up the order yourself or ordered delivery — you can pay by card in either case, as our couriers always have terminals.
delivery.payOnlineDesc: Payment via the website payment system using bank card, Yandex Money, WebMoney, etc. Please note that the commission depends on the payment method.
delivery.payBanklessDesc: We always act in the interests of buyers, so we provide the opportunity to pay for the product non-cash. Contact our managers at +7 (812) 704-86-97 for all necessary information.
delivery.payCreditDesc: Sometimes the desire to own a gadget doesn't quite match the ability to pay the full amount at once. We cooperate with many banks — credit processing is very fast. Call: +7 (812) 704-86-97.
delivery.ctaTitle: Choose your tech, we'll take care of delivery
